data.title: AMD Sinks 10.5% as Chip Rally Unwinds, Nasdaq 100 Falls 1.7%: Stock Market Today
data.description: AMD lost about $100 billion as traders unwound the post-Huang chip rotation, Nvidia's China scandal deepened and Cisco slid on margins. QQQ fell 1.7%.

data.title: AMD Stock Has Outrun Nvidia 5X Since 2024. But There’s a Valuation Catch
data.description: AMD has outperformed Nvidia 5X since 2024, but its forward P/E is more than three times higher. Can growth justify the premium?

data.title: Tandem Mobi Becomes Only Insulin Pump Offering Both Tubed and Tubeless Wear Options

data.title: Nvidia Courting a Former Insider: Arm CEO Rene Haas
data.description: Nvidia reportedly approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor to Jensen Huang, with CFO Colette Kress serving as interim CEO amid turmoil.
